title: PipelinePolicy
description: The one global turn pipeline policy (ADR-0045 §3, ADR-0051): step cap + context budgets + auto-RAG top-k + thinking/window/session-budget/compaction policy.

maxSteps.description: Global dispatch/observe bound (one pipeline for every preset).

maxRagTokens.description: Auto-RAG budget; 0 drops all retrieved chunks.

maxMentionTokens.description: Mention budget; 0 truncates all mention content (labeled).

thinking.description: Default thinking policy level (ADR-0051 §1); a session policy or per-turn override may replace it.

maxThinkingTokens.description: Reasoning-token cap (ADR-0051 §5); hitting it labels thinking-truncated. Generous enough not to truncate before a tool call.

reserveOutputTokens.description: Window-gate output reserve (ADR-0051 §6): max_tokens plus a safety margin held back from the context window.

sessionBudgetSoftRatio.description: Soft session-budget threshold as a ratio of Session.tokenBudget (ADR-0051 §7).

enabled.description: Whether metered compaction may run when history exceeds the trigger.

triggerHistoryTokens.description: History-token trigger above which compaction runs.

keepRecentTurns.description: Number of most-recent turns that survive compaction.

decision.description: The one global Laya decision-layer policy (ADR-0053). Off by default; never per-preset.

enabled.description: Whether the Laya decision layer is enabled globally (a session/per-turn ContextPolicy.decision may override).

model.description: The Laya service resolved by name via Fleet.

gateThreshold.description: Engine-applied keep threshold τ on the gate's per-chunk P(relevant).

maxCandidates.description: Maximum candidate chunks sent to the gate (bounded by Laya's batch cap).

maxHistoryTurns.description: Recent history turns the planner sees.

breadthTopK.description: Maps the planner's breadth choice to a retrieval topK.

timeoutMs.description: Per-call deadline for a Laya request; a timeout degrades fail-open and labeled.
